reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The EBRD will provide up to EUR25 million loan to Kipas Mensucat to support Company's funding needs to (i) repair damaged factory buildings and replace/repair new machinery, (ii) support working capital to pay accrued VAT and corporate taxes and (iii) pay accrued social security premiums while supporting other HR related expenses. Project objective is to mitigate the impact of the devastating earthquake and EBRD loan proceeds will address subsequent working capital needs and maintain extra liquidity buffer. The support under the proposed loan is crucial to preserve livelihoods, entrepreneurial and human capital in the aftermath of the disaster. Adequate working capital will ensure the Company to continue its day-to-day operations without facing any disruptions.
